about.credits_desc: Made in Rust with GPUI and gpui-kit. Icons: Lucide (ISC) and Simple Icons (CC0); the brands belong to their owners.
about.disclaimer: Independent, unofficial project, not affiliated with Bitwarden Inc.
about.license_desc: Open source: use, study and change it.
about.tagline: Password manager for Windows, compatible with Bitwarden and Vaultwarden.
app.autotype_own_window: Open the app you want to sign in to and press {hotkey} there.
app.autotype_reprompt: This item asks for your vault password. Confirm it and it will be typed.
app.browser_disabled: Browser filling is turned off in Scout Vault.
app.hello_next_unlock: Windows Hello will turn on the next time you unlock with your vault password.
app.hello_not_ready: Windows Hello isn't ready. Use your vault password.
app.hello_password_changed: Your vault password changed. Turn Windows Hello on again in Settings.
app.quick_unlock_password_changed: Your vault password changed. Next time, the app will ask for the new one.
app.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
app.tray_hint_body: It stays here by the clock. Click to open, or right-click to quit.
app.tray_icon_failed: Couldn't add the icon next to the clock: {e}
app.unlock_to_fill_browser: Unlock the vault to fill in the browser.
app.unlock_to_save_login: Unlock the vault to save the login for {host}.
autotype.blocked: Windows didn't allow typing. The other window may be running as administrator.
autotype.cant_verify: This app doesn't say whether the field is a password field. Make sure the cursor is in the username field before typing.
autotype.hotkey_taken: Another program already uses the {hotkey} shortcut ({e}).
autotype.lost_focus: The other window lost focus, so typing stopped.
autotype.not_password_field: The focused field isn't a password field, so I stopped before typing the password. Click the username field and try again.
autotype.windows_only: Filling in other apps only works on Windows for now.
browser.reprompt: This item asks for the vault password. Use Scout Vault to copy or type it.
browser.wrong_site: This login isn't for this site.
dnd.into_itself: A folder can't go inside itself.
editor.collection_required: Choose at least one of the organization's collections.
editor.collections: Collections (anyone with access to them sees the item)
editor.reprompt: Ask for the vault password to view
field.title: Title
flow.2fa_required: The server asked for a second factor.
flow.attachment_gone: The attachment is no longer on the item.
flow.cant_connect: Couldn't reach the server. Check the address and your internet connection.
flow.captcha: The server asked for a captcha, which Scout Vault can't show. Sign in once on the web vault (vault.bitwarden.com) and try again.
flow.device_code_required: The server asked for the code sent to your email.
flow.invalid_2fa: Wrong or expired code. Check it and try again.
flow.invalid_device_code: Wrong code. Use the latest one in your email.
flow.item_gone: This item is no longer in the vault. Sync and try again.
flow.kdf_failed: Couldn't open the vault with that password: {e}
flow.key_connector_unsupported: This account opens the vault through your company's Key Connector, which Scout Vault doesn't support yet.
flow.missing_user_key: The server didn't send the account key. Accounts that sign in only with SSO or a trusted device don't work yet.
flow.no_master_password: This account doesn't have a vault password yet. Create one in the web vault and try again.
flow.no_storage: There's no room for this file: the account's attachment storage is full.
flow.outdated: The Bitwarden server rejected this Scout Vault version as too old. Update Scout Vault to a newer version.
flow.premium_required: Attachments need Bitwarden Premium (or an organization). Free bitwarden.com accounts can't upload files.
flow.prompt_duo: Approve in Duo in your browser and paste the final page's address here.
flow.prompt_webauthn: Click the button and touch your security key (or use Windows Hello).
flow.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
flow.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
flow.sso_2fa_unsupported: Your company asks for a second check after SSO, which Scout Vault doesn't support yet.
flow.sso_no_email: The server didn't send the account email during SSO sign-in.
flow.sso_password_required: Enter your vault password: it opens the vault after SSO.
flow.trusted_device_unsupported: This account uses "trusted device" instead of a vault password, which Scout Vault (like the official CLI) doesn't support.
flow.unsupported_crypto: This account uses a protection format (type {t}) that Scout Vault doesn't know yet.
flow.webauthn_no_data: The server didn't send the security key data.
generator.subtitle: Made right here. Nothing is sent to the server.
generator.title: Password generator
health.all_good: All good: no password needs attention.
health.no_exposed: No passwords showed up in known leaks.
health.no_old: No passwords older than a year.
health.nothing_to_check: No logins with passwords to check.
health.pwned_explain: Compares your passwords with billions of leaked ones (Have I Been Pwned). Only a tiny scrambled piece of each password leaves this computer; the comparison happens here. Your password is never sent.
health.pwned_failed: Couldn't check for leaks. Check your internet connection and try again.
health.subtitle: Weak, reused, old or leaked passwords. Click an item to open it.
health.title: Password health
hello.canceled: Windows Hello canceled. Use your vault password.
hello.failed: Windows Hello couldn't open the vault: {e}
hello.key_changed: the Windows Hello key changed; turn the option on again
hello.password_changed: your vault password changed; turn the option on again
hud.locked_hint: The vault is locked. Type the password to continue.
icons.local_only: Only on this computer. The item doesn't change on the server.
icons.title: Item icon
login.duo_paste_url: Paste the address of the page that opened after you approved in Duo.
login.enter_email_code: Enter the code sent by email.
login.new_device: First time on this computer: enter the code sent to your email.
login.signing_in: Signing in… this takes a few seconds
login.sso_busy: Finish signing in in the browser that opened…
login.sso_password_required: Enter your vault password: it opens the vault after SSO.
login.subtitle: Use a Bitwarden account or one from a compatible server.
login.subtitle_new_device: We sent a code to your email.
login.title: Sign in
login.unsupported_2fa: This account requires {names}, which Scout Vault doesn't support yet.
login.use_webauthn: Use a security key or Windows Hello
login.webauthn_busy: Touch your security key or confirm in Windows Hello…
profile.no_organizations: You aren't part of any organization.
profile.open_web_vault_hint: Change the password, email or 2FA on the server's site.
profile.unlock_memory: Ask for the password on open
quick.footer: ↵ fill/open · Ctrl+P password · Ctrl+U username · Ctrl+T code · Ctrl+O open · Esc close
quick.placeholder: Search the vault — name, username or website
quick.title: Quick search
settings.accent_desc: Used for selection, focus and primary buttons.
settings.auto_lock_desc: Time without touching the keyboard or mouse until the vault locks.
settings.autotype_desc: With the vault open, the shortcut types username ⇥ password in any window. Change it under Shortcuts.
settings.autotype_enter_desc: Submits the form after typing the password.
settings.background_sync_desc: Every minute the app checks whether the vault changed somewhere else (your phone, the web vault…) and updates itself.
settings.browser_fill_desc: Lets the Scout Vault extension (Chrome, Edge, Brave) ask this app for logins. Only works while the vault is unlocked.
settings.clipboard_clear_desc: Copied passwords and codes disappear on their own after this long, unless you copy something else. They never go into the Win+V history.
settings.close_to_tray: Keep running by the clock when closed
settings.close_to_tray_desc: The app keeps running by the clock, so the shortcuts and the browser keep working. To quit for real, use Quit on the icon.
settings.hud_opacity_desc: Quick search, filling in other apps and the menu by the clock. Below 100%, what is behind shows through, blurred.
settings.install_extension_desc: In the browser, open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions), turn on Developer mode, click "Load unpacked" and pick the folder below. Then, on a site, click the Scout Vault icon or press Ctrl+Shift+L.
settings.language_desc: Language of the app's text. "System" follows the Windows language.
settings.lock_on_minimize_desc: Minimizing the window or closing it to the clock locks the vault right away.
settings.lock_with_windows_desc: When you lock the computer (Win+L) or it sleeps/hibernates, the vault locks too.
settings.motion_desc: Interface animations and the login background art. "Still" turns everything off.
settings.quick_search_desc: From any app, opens a small window to find an item and fill, copy the username, the password or the code, without opening Scout Vault.
settings.relogin: Ask for a full login every
settings.relogin_desc: After this long, the app asks for your email, vault password and two-step verification again. Changing your password or signing out elsewhere also asks you to sign in.
settings.remember_session_desc: When you open the app, it only asks for your vault password. The vault is kept protected on this computer and opens even without internet.
settings.server_url_required: Enter the server address, starting with https://
settings.subtitle: Changes apply right away and are saved on this computer.
settings.theme_desc: Light, dark or the same as the system.
settings.title: Settings
settings.unlock_memory: Ask for the vault password on open
settings.unlock_memory_desc: After you type your password, the app opens straight away for this long. Anyone using this computer with your Windows account opens the vault without a password during that time. If the password changes, it's asked again.
settings.windows_hello_desc: Use your Windows face, fingerprint or PIN instead of your vault password. If your vault password changes, turn it on again.
settings.windows_hello_unavailable: Windows Hello is not set up on this computer (Windows Settings › Accounts › Sign-in options).
shortcuts.autotype_desc: Types username ⇥ password in the focused window (or shows the list).
shortcuts.in_use: The other shortcut already uses it.
shortcuts.needs_modifier: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win with the key.
shortcuts.quick_search_desc: Opens the vault search on top of any app.
shortcuts.unsupported_key: Use a letter, a number, F1–F24 or Space.
sso.mismatch: The SSO sign-in response didn't match. Try again.
sso.page_fail_body: Go back to Scout Vault and try again.
sso.page_ok_body: You can close this tab and go back to Scout Vault.
sso.ports_busy: Ports 8065 to 8070 are in use (another Bitwarden app open?). Close it and try again.
sso.timeout: SSO sign-in took too long. Try again.
tray.pin_hint: Pin items to see them here.
ui.drop_here: Drag files here or click to choose
ui.drop_hint: Documents, images… up to 500 MB each. Everything is protected before it leaves your computer.
vault.busy_syncing: Scout Vault is syncing. Try again in a moment.
vault.folder_deleted: Folder deleted. Its items moved to No folder.
vault.form_open: You're editing an item in Scout Vault. Save or cancel and try again.
vault.item_gone: This item is no longer in the vault.
vault.no_totp: This item has no authenticator code.
vault.pins_full: Quick access already has {n} items. Remove one first.
vault.reprompt_body: To see, copy, edit or fill it, confirm it's you.
vault.reprompt_title: This item asks for your vault password
vault.save_before_move: Save or cancel your edit before moving items.
vault.select_item: Select an item to see its details.
vault.select_item_hint: Use the arrow keys in the list. Enter opens the item.
vault.updated_elsewhere: Vault updated with changes from another device
vault.wait_sync: Wait for the sync to finish.
webauthn.canceled: The security key check was canceled.
webauthn.no_challenge: The server didn't send the security key challenge.
webauthn.windows_only: Security keys only work on Windows for now.
